name: Garry's Mod Server
description: Official SRCDS dedicated server for Garry's Mod, installed through Valve's SteamCMD (anonymous).

details.about:
Garry's Mod is Facepunch's physics sandbox built on Valve's Source engine. It has no fixed goals. Players spawn props, ragdolls, NPCs and vehicles, weld contraptions together and play a huge range of community gamemodes, from Trouble in Terrorist Town and Prop Hunt to DarkRP.

A dedicated Garry's Mod server runs Valve's Source Dedicated Server (SRCDS). It lets you choose the gamemode, map rotation, player slots and admin tools, and install addons from the Steam Workshop or drop .gma files into the addons folder.

The server is free to download through SteamCMD. Facepunch's wiki recommends a Game Server Login Token so your server is ranked properly in the server browser.
features: Official SRCDS dedicated server, installed anonymously via SteamCMD (app 4020)
Run sandbox or any installed gamemode (+gamemode)
Lua scripting for custom gamemodes and server-side tools
setup_tips: The app starts srcds.exe with -console -game garrysmod +map gm_construct +maxplayers 16 -port 27015. Edit these to change the starting map or slot count.
Generate a Game Server Login Token for app 4000 on Steam and add +sv_setsteamaccount <token>. Facepunch says servers without one are penalized in the browser ranking.
Add +host_workshop_collection <collectionID> to download a Workshop collection automatically, or place .gma files in garrysmod\addons.
Pick a gamemode with +gamemode (for example sandbox or terrortown) and make sure its files are installed.
Allow 27015 (UDP for players, TCP for RCON) in Firewall Rules or with Connect to Tunnel. Set rcon_password in garrysmod\cfg\server.cfg only if you need remote RCON.
